body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> LG showcased its new Shine phone during CES 2008, which supports HSDPA.
According to LG, the Shine is for those who were born to shine because the company has created the blend of minimalist design and maximum functionality.

When idle, the Shine has a unique, reflective mirror finish, but once it is active the screen comes alive and is viewable from all angles. Inside the elegant stainless steel body, Shine packs in a music player, a 2.0 megapixel camera, video share and Bluetooth® capabilities, a full array of messaging options, and more.
